summary: Decomposition is correct: the promoted story preserves the original two independently testable behaviors as WI-05ca (ending-variant simulation rules: decision branches to 2+ endings, one-shot trigger, credits flag, restart) and WI-05cb (save-schema extension: version bump with trivial migration, pre-descent and post-trigger autosave points per request section 25). Each child is a strict subset of the parent's three subsystems and stays within one testable behavior with at most three changed responsibilities. The sole parent criterion AC-end-variants is carried verbatim by both children, and the full fresh-save ending scenario with save-reload at each milestone is explicitly assigned as final proof to the dependent owner WI-05ca. Dependencies are acyclic and correct (story and WI-05cb on WI-05b; WI-05ca on WI-05b plus WI-05cb for the autosave points it consumes), with no ancestor or descendant edges. Request sections 24, 25, 70 and 72 were checked against the spec's claims (variant count and 'decision plus different final state/text/shot', autosave points, duplicate-trigger and credits/restart checks, second variant as cut candidate) and match. Boundary note: WI-05ca's final proof traverses WI-05a/WI-05b features only as integration evidence of the ending behavior, not new scope; the story handoff and both leaf handoffs give a fresh implementer the exact sections, files, and spoiler/private-content constraints. Observed for the parent's next review: ST-05/plan.md's 'final proof owner: WI-05c' line predates the promotion and now resolves through this story to WI-05ca.
